Independent Streamlit application repository.

Bike rental demand: a prediction interface

A simple interface for single and batch rental-demand predictions using weather and time inputs.

Python · Streamlit · pandas · scikit-learn · Random Forest

The question

A model is easier to explore when people can enter scenarios and inspect predictions.

The work

  • Convert dates, weather and seasonal fields into the expected model features.
  • Support a single-scenario form and CSV batch uploads.
  • Provide demo data, result tables and prediction charts.

What the repository demonstrates

  • Public app code includes single and batch prediction flows and a saved random-forest model.

What I learned

  • Keep inference feature preparation consistent with the trained model.

Project context

  • No actual app screenshot was present in the public repository; use a code/feature preview instead of inventing one.
  • Not assumed to be the same model as the separate AutoGluon coursework.
Source references

This is a curated local case study based on the public project repository, not a rerun of the original analysis.
